// why: A project nx takes from a `package.json` and not from a `project.json`, with a `.local.env` in its root. It is the last place of the walk, so a rule that stops one place short, or reads `project.json` alone, passes it.

addRoots.name: package.json
addRoots.reason: The package manager reads a manifest by this name in every package of the workspace.
